title: CSAIL Primary Logo and MIT Schwarzman College of Computing Logo
slide_intent: Teach a designer to balance two institutional marks by their visible features. Aligning letter and symbol baselines gives each affiliation a stable place.
strategic_value: CSAIL can acknowledge its relationship with the college while preserving the clear space of both marks.
demonstration: Three diagrams compare side-by-side orders and a vertical arrangement. Cyan and magenta guides mark symbol height, baseline and minimum gaps.
practical_value: Match the CSAIL mark height to the college symbol as closely as possible and use the larger CSAIL clearance when the safety areas meet.

content_islands.name: Measurement guidance
content_islands.spec: Explain relative height, initial baseline and minimum separation in the left column.

content_islands.name: Lockup construction
content_islands.spec: Stack three diagrams in ruled bands. Use separate guide colors for the lab and college artwork and label coinciding heights or minimum spaces.
